units.source_text: 薰君想起久不赴宇治了，便动身前往访问八亲王。

en.t: Lord Kaoru remembered that he had not gone to Uji for a long time, and set out to visit the Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 这时候正是初秋七月。

en.t: It was then the seventh month, in early autumn.

units.source_text: 都城里还不大看得出秋色，但一走到音羽山附近，便觉凉风送爽。

en.t: In the capital there was still little sign of autumn, but once he reached the area around Mount Otowa, he felt a refreshing cool breeze.

units.source_text: 槙尾山一带的树木上已经略见红叶。

en.t: On the trees around Mount Makio, the red leaves were already faintly visible.

units.source_text: 入山越深，景色越是优美而新奇。

en.t: The deeper he went into the mountains, the more beautiful and novel the scenery became.

units.source_text: 薰君在这时候来访，八亲王比往常更加欢迎。

en.t: Because Lord Kaoru visited at this time, the Eighth Prince welcomed him even more warmly than usual.

units.source_text: 这一次他对薰君说了许多伤心的话。

en.t: This time he spoke many sorrowful words to Lord Kaoru.

units.source_text: 向他嘱托道：“我死之后，希望你在得便之时，常来看看这两个女儿，请勿舍弃她们。”

en.t: He entrusted them to him, saying, "After I die, I hope that whenever it is convenient, you will often come to look in on these two daughters of mine. Please do not abandon them."

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“以前早已承蒙嘱咐，侄儿牢记在心，决不怠慢。

en.t: Lord Kaoru replied, "You entrusted this to me long ago, and I have kept it firmly in mind. I will never neglect it.

units.source_text: 侄儿对俗世已无留恋，一身力求简朴。

en.t: I no longer have any attachment to the world, and I try to keep my own life simple.

units.source_text: 万事都不可靠，前途毫无指望。

en.t: Nothing in the world can be relied on, and there is no hope at all in what lies ahead.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，但只要一日生存在世，此志一日不变，可请皇叔放心。”

en.t: Even so, as long as I remain alive in this world, my resolve will not change for a single day, so please set your mind at ease."

units.source_text: 八亲王不胜喜慰。

en.t: The Eighth Prince was deeply pleased and comforted.

units.source_text: 夜色渐深，明月出天，似觉远山都移近来了。

en.t: As the night deepened and the bright moon rose into the sky, even the distant mountains seemed to have drawn nearer.

units.source_text: 八亲王伤心地念了一会经之后，又和薰君闲谈往事。

en.t: After sadly chanting sutras for a while, the Eighth Prince again chatted with Lord Kaoru about the past.

units.source_text: 他说：“现今世间不知怎么样了。

en.t: He said, "I wonder what the world is like nowadays.

units.source_text: 从前宫中等处，每当此种月明如昼的秋夜，必在御前演奏音乐，我也常得参与其间。

en.t: In the past, at the palace and other such places, on autumn nights like this when the moon was bright as day, music would always be performed before His Majesty, and I too was often able to take part.

units.source_text: 那时所有以擅长音乐著名的人，各献妙技，参与合奏。

en.t: At those times, everyone famous for skill in music would display their finest talents and join in the ensemble.

units.source_text: 但我觉得这种演奏，规模太庞大了，倒不如几位长于此道的女御、更衣的室内演奏来得有味：

en.t: But I felt that such performances were too grand in scale, and that the chamber music of several consorts and ladies of the wardrobe who excelled in the art had more savor:

units.source_text: 她们内心里针锋相对，而表面上和睦相亲，于夜深人静之际奏出沁人肺腑的曲调。

en.t: Inwardly they rivaled one another sharply, yet outwardly they were harmonious and affectionate, and in the deep quiet of the night they played melodies that pierced the heart.

units.source_text: 那隐约传来的声音，耐人听赏的实在很多。

en.t: Among those faint sounds drifting over, there was truly much that rewarded attentive listening.

units.source_text: 从任何方面来说，女子作为游乐时的对手，最为相宜。

en.t: From every point of view, women are the most fitting companions for refined amusement.

units.source_text: 她们虽然纤弱，却有感动人心的魅力。

en.t: Though they are delicate, they possess a charm that moves the heart.

units.source_text: 正因为如此，佛说女人是罪障深重的。

en.t: It is precisely for this reason that the Buddha says women are burdened with deep karmic hindrances.

units.source_text: 就父母爱子的辛劳而言，男子似乎不大需要父母操心吧？

en.t: When it comes to the hardships parents endure out of love for their children, sons seem not to require so much worry, do they?

units.source_text: 而女子呢，如果嫁了一个不良之人，即使是命运所迫，为父母者还是要为她伤心。”

en.t: But with daughters, if one marries an unworthy man, even if fate has forced it, her parents still cannot help grieving for her."

units.source_text: 他说的是一般人之事，但他自己哪得不怀着此种心情？

en.t: He was speaking of people in general, but how could he himself not harbor just such feelings?

units.source_text: 薰君推察其心，觉得十分同情。

en.t: Lord Kaoru guessed what was in his heart and felt great sympathy for him.

units.source_text: 答道：“侄儿对一切世俗之事，确已无所留恋。

en.t: He replied, "I truly have no lingering attachment to any worldly matter.

units.source_text: 自身也毫无一件精通的技艺。

en.t: Nor do I myself possess a single art in which I am accomplished.

units.source_text: 惟有音乐听赏一事，虽然谈不上怎样，却实在难于舍弃。

en.t: Only the listening and appreciation of music, though I cannot claim any great skill in it, is truly hard for me to give up.

units.source_text: 那位大智大慧的圣僧迦叶尊者，想来也是为此，所以忘威仪而闻琴起舞吧。”

en.t: Surely it was for this reason that the holy monk Mahakasyapa, a man of great wisdom, forgot his dignity and danced when he heard the qin."

units.source_text: 他前曾听到女公子们一两声琴音，常觉不能餍足，恳切盼望再听。

en.t: He had once heard a note or two from the young ladies' instruments, and since then had always felt unsatisfied, earnestly longing to hear them again.

units.source_text: 八亲王想必是欲以此作为他们互相亲近的开端，所以亲自走进女公子室中，谆切地劝她们弹。

en.t: The Eighth Prince must have wished to make this the beginning of closer acquaintance between them, for he personally went into the young ladies' room and earnestly urged them to play.

units.source_text: 大女公子只得取过筝来，略弹数声就停止了。

en.t: The elder young lady had no choice but to take up the zheng, play a few notes, and then stop.

units.source_text: 此时万籁俱寂，室内肃静无声。

en.t: At that moment all sounds were still, and the room was solemn and silent.

units.source_text: 天空气色与四周光景都很动人。

en.t: The look of the sky and the scenery all around were deeply moving.

units.source_text: 薰君心驰神往，颇思参与女公子们的随意不拘的演奏。

en.t: Lord Kaoru was carried away in spirit, and very much wanted to join the young ladies in their free and unrestrained playing.

units.source_text: 然而女公子们岂肯毫无顾忌地与他合奏呢？

en.t: Yet how could the young ladies possibly play together with him without the least reserve?

units.source_text: 八亲王说：“我现在让你们熟悉一下，以后就看你们年轻人自己的喽。”

en.t: The Eighth Prince said, "For now I am just letting you become a little familiar with one another. After this, it will be up to you young people yourselves."

units.source_text: 他准备上佛堂做功课去，赋诗赠薰君云：

en.t: He prepared to go to the Buddhist hall for his devotions, and composed a poem to present to Lord Kaoru:
